disposition_reason: ICP OES results for 17 elements in eight Brazilian cereal-based complementary foods (8 units each) are tabulated per product; Pb was quantified in five products and As and Cd were below LOD.

study.design: Retail survey of eight commercial cereal-based complementary foods for children over six months, with intake and risk assessment
study.market: supermarkets, Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil
study.qa: Spike recovery at 0.5 ppm: 83-114% (Pb 98%, Cd 100%, As 99%); no CRM reported
